SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how personal responsibility can be derived from the narrative’s moral lessons. 1. How can you identify the main events in a trickster narrative?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
